acquisition method: A data-dependent top 5 method was operated
alkylation reagent: carbamidomethylated with 7.5 mM iodoacetamide (final concentration) at room temperature in the dark for 15 min.
alkylation concentration: carbamidomethylated with 7.5 mM iodoacetamide (final concentration) at room temperature in the dark for 15 min.
cleavage agent: enzymatic hydrolyses were performed by the addition of 0.2 µg of tosyl phenylalanyl chloromethyl ketone (TPCK)-treated trypsin to the reduced and alkylated mixture.
enrichment method: Protein complexes were purified by immunoprecipitation and subsequent protein-A affinity pulldown by using a method optimized as compared with that described by Marino et al..
fragmentation method: higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) spectra were obtained
instrument: Mass spectrometry analysis was performed on a Q-Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometer
ionization type: equipped with an EASY-Spray nano-electrospray ion source
mass analyzer: Full scans and Orbitrap MS/MS scans were acquired in profile mode, whereas ion trap mass spectra were acquired in centroid mode.
precursor tolerance: The mass tolerances were set to 10 ppm and 0.02 Da for precursor and fragment ions, respectively.
fragment tolerance: The mass tolerances were set to 10 ppm and 0.02 Da for precursor and fragment ions, respectively.
ptm: Oxidation of methionine (+15.995 Da) dynamic; N-terminal acetylation (+42.011 Da) dynamic; carbamidomethylation of cysteine (+57.021 Da) static
Oxidation of methionine (+15.995 Da) and N-terminal acetylation (+42.011 Da) were set as dynamic modifications and carbamidomethylation of cysteine (+57.021 Da) as static modification.
reduction reagent: Proteins were reduced with 10 mM dithiothreitol (final concentration) at 55 °C for 1 h
reduction concentration: Proteins were reduced with 10 mM dithiothreitol (final concentration) at 55 °C for 1 h
